_brief: A Taiwanese man in his mid-thirties speaking Taiwan Mandarin with a natural Taiwanese accent, no Beijing retroflex or erhua. Low, warm, magnetic voice with a slight rasp and breathiness. Relaxed and laid-back, like a late-night tech podcast host chatting with a friend, occasionally self-deprecating. Mixes English tech terms naturally.
